title: Bounded constructible integral p-adic module complexes form a triangulated subcategory
statement: Let X be a scheme with noetherian underlying topological space, ℓ a prime, and E a finite intermediate field of the fixed algebraic closure of ℚ_ℓ. Give E the norm induced by this embedding. For the continuous integral coefficient ring of [def-weil-pbc-continuous-integral-coefficients], equivalently the ring object Profinite.padicIntegersRingObj ℓ E pulled back to X, bounded complexes with constructible cohomology form a triangulated subcategory. Constructibility and boundedness are those of [prop-weil-pbc-module-bounded-constructible-triangulated].

source.place: Definition 6.8.10 and Proposition 6.8.11(1),(3), integral finite-presentation comparison, as recorded by lem-weil-pbc-integral-constructible-serre

proof.text: Use the norm induced from the algebraic closure on E. The scalar tower and multiplicativity of the algebraic-closure norm prove the normed algebra inequality. With this norm the valuation ring used for continuous integral coefficients is definitionally the ring of integers used by Profinite.padicIntegersRingObj.

Apply integralConstructible_serre to obtain kernel, cokernel and extension closure for this actual coefficient ring. Identify the coefficient objects definitionally, then apply the conditional bounded constructible triangulation instance.
